articles.title: Yemen’s Houthis attack Saudi airport as tensions with Riyadh escalate
articles.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen launched missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia's Abha International Airport. This action was in retaliation for recent airstrikes, which the Houthis blamed on Riyadh, targeting Sanaa International Airport. The escalating tit-for-tat attacks underscore the deepening military conflict and regional instability in the ongoing Yemen war, highlighting persistent tensions in the region.

articles.title: US reinstates Strait of Hormuz blockade as Trump proposes 20% cargo fee
articles.summary: US President Trump announced reinstating a blockade on Iran in the strategic Strait of Hormuz. This policy shift means other ships will be charged for safe passage, escalating tensions with Tehran. The move significantly impacts international maritime trade and security through this vital global chokepoint, highlighting the US's assertive stance against Iran's regional influence.

articles.title: Iranian missiles struck oil tankers in Hormuz - UAE
articles.summary: An Indian crew member was killed and eight wounded after Iranian cruise missiles struck two Emirati oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The UAE Ministry of Defence confirmed the attack, highlighting escalating tensions and maritime security risks in this critical global shipping lane. This incident underscores potential threats to international trade and Indian nationals working overseas.
